# local-storage

Local Storage operator exposing node-local disks as PVs

```yaml
stack:
  localStorage:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Which disks to claim, and what to call the resulting StorageClass

Under `stack.localStorage.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `storageClassName` | StorageClass created from the claimed disks. Point ODF's deviceSet at this. | `nvme-storageclass` |
| `volumeMode` | Block for ODF OSDs; Filesystem for general local PVs | `Block` |
| `deviceTypes` | Device classes to claim | `[disk]` |
| `minSize` | Ignore devices smaller than this; keeps boot and OS disks out | `200G` |
| `maxSize` | Optional upper bound | `''` |
| `nodeSelectorKey` | Node label marking the nodes whose disks are claimed. Matches the label the storage-nodes element applies. | `cluster.ocs.openshift.io/openshift-storage` |

## Operators

Each also renders `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-local-storage` | `local-storage-operator` | `stable` | `redhat-operators` | `openshift-local-storage` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CP-9 System Backup. Categories: CP Contingency Planning.

### Policy `install`

`install-local-storage-<cluster>`: Install and manage the Local Storage operator.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `install-local-storage` | enforce | [operator](#operators) `local-storage-operator` | Local Storage operator |

### Policy `volumes`

`volumes-local-storage-<cluster>`: Claim local disks on the storage nodes. Depends on `install-local-storage-<cluster>`, `ready-storage-nodes-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Waits for | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `volumes-volumeset` | enforce | `install-local-storage-status`<br>compliant while pending | [local-volume-set](converters/local-volume-set.yaml) | LocalVolumeSet claiming node-local disks |
